rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an everyday morning, especially the earlier part of the day.

example.english: I go to the wet market first thing in the morning to buy groceries.
example.traditional: 朝頭早我就去街市買餸。
example.jyutping: ziu1 tau4 zou2 ngo5 zau6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3

rows.note: Use this when you mean the morning as the time before noon, including later morning.

example.english: We have a meeting at the office in the morning.
example.jyutping: soeng6 zau3 ngo5 dei6 hai2 gung1 si1 hoi1 wui2
